title: Mercosur
goal: Read how the 1991 Treaty of Asunción created Mercosur among four countries, its trade goals, the 1985 Argentina-Brazil rapprochement behind it, and the dominance of Brazil and Argentina in the bloc's decisions.

items: State when and by whom the Treaty of Asunción was signed.
Explain how the 1985 Alfonsín-Sarney rapprochement preceded Mercosur.
Explain why Brazil and Argentina dominated the bloc's decisions.
